Good morning group, in May my wife and I received approval of my wife entry and we were asked to deposit 30,000 shekels. Since my circumstances in the present time are not so great i sent an appeal letter. in 12 of may they replied our email that it was sent to the branch manager to review. Since then i have sent emails and even went to our branch in Ramla last Sunday and the clerk familiar with our case told me that she will ask for urgency and let the branch manager know that i was there. 
It’s been 40 days, is this normal? Do they branch mananger have a timeline that is supposed to solve an appeal or can he just drag it as much as he/she wants ? Thank you 😊
